name: scenario_1088
description: The user is managing professional contacts and communications, organizing team members, vendor details, and preparing a mass outreach email while respecting an opt-out list.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Check my 'Team Roster' note. Look at the users in these system settings screenshots. If either user's email is not already in that note, add them as a new contact in my phone with their name and email, and then update the note to include them.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'Team Roster' note and filter the users shown in the two system settings screenshots. Instruct it that if a user's email is not already in the note, it should add them to your contacts and append their information to the note. Since you have multiple 'Team Roster' notes, the assistant should ask you to clarify which one you mean. When it does, specify that you are referring to the work one for NexaLink. Once the assistant confirms the necessary contact has been created and the note updated, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3, image_4, image_5]
Query: These screenshots show the startup screen of our statistical software. Check my 'Vendor Contacts' note. If the vendor is not already listed in that note, add them to my phone contacts with their email and both phone numbers, and then append their info to the 'Vendor Contacts' note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check your 'Vendor Contacts' note. It should extract the vendor's contact details from the software startup screenshots and check if they are already listed in the note. If not, tell it to add the vendor to your contacts with their email and both phone numbers, and then update the note with this new information. If the assistant asks for clarification on which phone numbers to include, confirm that it should use both the toll-free alphanumeric number and the direct line. Once the assistant confirms the contact and note are updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_6]
Query: Look at this old email client screenshot and extract all explicit email addresses visible anywhere on the screen. Check my 'Opt-Out List' note. Filter the extracted email addresses by removing any that appear in the opt-out note. Create a new draft email in Gmail addressed to the remaining email addresses with the subject 'Reconnecting'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to extract all explicitly visible email addresses from the old email client screenshot. Instruct it to check your 'Opt-Out List' note and remove any extracted emails that are on that list. Finally, ask it to create a new draft email addressed to the remaining extracted emails with the subject 'Reconnecting'. If the assistant lists the extracted emails and asks for confirmation before drafting, tell it to proceed. End the conversation once the draft is successfully created.
